Explore the Past, Shape the Future
Why Study Geological Sciences
Welcome to the Department of Geological Sciences
We explore the dynamic processes and complex histories of Earth and other planets while creating and sharing the knowledge needed to shape a more sustainable future.
Our department prioritizes cutting-edge research in the diverse disciplines of Earth and Planetary Sciences, providing students with the skills needed to respond to the challenges and opportunities our society faces and serving the public on issues related to Earth Science.
